landing.eyebrow: A clearer view of school life
landing.heroDescription: Madrasaty brings recorded attendance, behavior, and homework together in one place, making it easier for parents to follow the information shared by the school.
landing.privacyNote: Parents sign in with a verification code sent through WhatsApp to the phone number registered with the school.
landing.whatsappDescription: Notifications may be sent when an absence is recorded or homework is assigned, according to the school’s workflow and notification settings.
landing.illustrationCaption: A feature illustration, not real student data.
landing.featuresTitle: Essential school information in one place
landing.featuresDescription: The portal shows actual information linked to your account, without invented statistics or sample testimonials.
landing.attendanceDescription: Review recorded attendance, lateness, and absences for lessons whose attendance records have been submitted by the school.
landing.behaviorDescription: Follow recorded positive and negative behavior entries and the points associated with the student.
landing.homeworkDescription: View assignments and due dates for the student’s class when they are available.
landing.notificationsDescription: WhatsApp notifications are tied to the school’s absence and homework workflows. Delivery may depend on the notification status.
landing.stepsDescription: Parents do not need to create a password. Use the student information already registered with the school to verify access.
landing.stepOneDescription: Enter the 14-digit national ID that matches the student’s record at the school.
landing.stepTwoDescription: A verification code is sent to the parent’s phone number registered with the school. Enter the code to sign in.
landing.stepThreeDescription: Review available attendance, behavior, and homework records. If your account is linked to more than one student, select the student you want from the student list.
landing.multiStudentDescription: Switch between students linked to your parent account using the student selector in the parent dashboard.
landing.footerNote: Nile Egyptian International Schools · Madrasaty Portal
landing.authSideDescription: Sign in to follow records for students linked to your account. Parents verify through WhatsApp, while teachers and school administrators use their email and password.
